empty.title: Empty folder
empty.description: This folder was empty at the time the backup was created. Add the missing files to the folder and create a new backup.

emptySearch.title: No files found
emptySearch.description: No files or folders matched your search query. Try a different query or add the missing files to the folder.

error.title: Failed to stop mount
error.description: The mount might still be in use. Try closing any applications that are using the mount.

restoreDialog.title: Restore folder
restoreDialog.description: Restore a folder from a backup.

compress.label: Compress ZIP file
compress.description: Reduces the size, but slows down the restore

warning.title: Files might be overwritten
warning.description: The selected folder is not empty. Existing files and folders could potentially be overwritten with the restored files. Consider creating a new empty folder instead.

confirmed.label: I understand that files might be overwritten

restore.actionError: Could not complete the action or refresh restore status. Try again.

issue.SPACE: The destination is full. Free space or choose another destination, then retry to a new folder.
issue.PERMISSION: Writing restored data or metadata was denied. Check destination permissions or choose another folder, then retry.
issue.ZIP: This engine's ZIP writer omits empty folders and symbolic links. Use unpacked restore to recover those items.
issue.DESTINATION: Check that the destination exists, has free space, allows writing and is not in use by another restore, then retry.
issue.ENGINE: The backup engine or its task result is unavailable. Reconnect the vault and check the destination before retrying.
issue.TASK: The engine could not restore all requested data. Check destination space and permissions and that the backup is readable, then retry to a new folder.
issue.TIMEOUT: The restore did not finish within the monitoring limit. Cancellation was requested; check the engine and destination before retrying.
issue.LINK: The destination contains a symbolic link or junction. Choose a folder without links to avoid writing outside the destination.
issue.CONFIRMATION: The destination is not empty. Confirm overwrite in the restore dialog or choose an empty folder.

restore.counts: Last reported restored items: {{restored}} · Skipped: {{skipped}} · Ignored errors: {{errors}}
restore.incomplete: Output may be incomplete. Keep the backup and inspect the destination before using restored files.
restore.title: Restore in progress
